findings.highlight: my head accepts it
findings.evidenceJa: 空っぽの頭は律儀にそれを受け入れている
findings.governingReading: his empty head dutifully, almost punctiliously, accepts every report of pain
findings.explanation: The grim personification of Shirou’s empty head continuing its duty is omitted.

findings.highlight: It’s my pain, so only I have to endure it
findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけの痛みなら、自分だけが耐えればいいだけ
findings.governingReading: If the pain is his alone, then he alone need only endure it.
findings.explanation: The repeated exclusivity distinguishing bodily pain from others’ pleas is weakened.

findings.highlight: the problem is the voices
findings.evidenceJa: 問題はこの声だった
findings.governingReading: the problem was this voice
findings.explanation: The victims’ collective voice is atomized before its identity is considered.

findings.highlight: I’m stabbed in the chest
findings.evidenceJa: 胸が深く抉られる
findings.governingReading: his chest is gouged deeply
findings.explanation: A visceral excavation image becomes a conventional stabbing.

findings.highlight: I just don’t have any way to atone to them
findings.evidenceJa: 贖う術が足り無すぎた
findings.governingReading: the means he has to make amends are far, far too inadequate
findings.explanation: Severe insufficiency becomes absolute absence and adds a direct object.

findings.highlight: I can’t help them
findings.evidenceJa: 応えてやる事ができない
findings.governingReading: he cannot answer/respond to them
findings.explanation: The torment of being unable to answer the dead is collapsed into practical rescue.

findings.highlight: I think my heart will break I’ll go crazy if this continues
findings.evidenceJa: 心が壊れると思った
findings.governingReading: he thought his heart would break if this continued
findings.explanation: An unsupported second prediction is fused into the sentence, leaving malformed revision debris.

findings.highlight: fix the contradiction of the living dead
findings.evidenceJa: 生かされている死体という矛盾を、正循に戻す
findings.governingReading: return the contradiction of corpses kept alive to its proper course/order
findings.explanation: The imposed life state and restoration to proper order are generalized.

findings.highlight: make the creator of this hell atone for his sins
findings.evidenceJa: この地獄を作り上げた原因に、償いをさせる
findings.governingReading: make the cause that produced this hell pay restitution
findings.explanation: An impersonal causal target is personified and assigned unspecified sins.

findings.highlight: A superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: An ally/champion of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s defining ethical ideal is again recast as a genre label.

findings.highlight: only exists to straighten out what has already happened
findings.evidenceJa: 起きた出来事を効率よく片づけるだけの存在
findings.governingReading: an existence that can only dispose efficiently of events after they occur
findings.explanation: The bitter limits of reactive, efficient cleanup are softened.

findings.highlight: I have no way to save them
findings.evidenceJa: 彼らに報いる術がない
findings.governingReading: he has no means to answer or make recompense to them
findings.explanation: The obligation toward people already dead becomes literal rescue.

findings.highlight: I don’t have enough power to deny his claim that a superhero is only so strong
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方なんてそんなものだと、吐き捨てたあいつを否定する力もない
findings.governingReading: he lacks even the power to refute the man who spat that an ally of justice is nothing more than that
findings.explanation: A contemptuously delivered categorical critique becomes a claim about power level.

findings.highlight: It’s coming from right behind me
findings.evidenceJa: 頭の真後ろから聞こえた声
findings.governingReading: a voice coming from directly behind his head
findings.explanation: The oppressive exact location is generalized.

findings.highlight: Let us go, Emiya Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: もう少し前に行こうか
findings.governingReading: let us move a little farther forward
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s incremental physical positioning of Shirou is omitted.

findings.highlight: was just like me
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎と同じだった
findings.governingReading: was the same as written “Emiya Shirou,” read “myself”
findings.explanation: The ruby binds Kotomine’s condition simultaneously to Shirou’s name and Shirou’s self; English preserves only the latter.

findings.highlight: His body had some kind of fatal wound
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの体にはひどい致命傷があって
findings.governingReading: his body has a terrible fatal wound
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s currently sustained lethal injury is shifted into an indefinite past state.

findings.highlight: Lower your sword
findings.evidenceJa: その剣を納めるがいい
findings.governingReading: Sheathe/put away that sword.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s demand to end hostilities becomes only changing the blade’s height.

findings.highlight: Things have turned out like this
findings.evidenceJa: 期せずしてこのような形になってしまった
findings.governingReading: Things have unexpectedly ended up in this form.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s claim that the situation was unintended is omitted from his manipulation.

findings.highlight: if you wish to seek the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を獲ろうというのなら
findings.governingReading: if you intend to take/obtain the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: A concrete offer of possession becomes continuing pursuit.

findings.highlight: you may continue fighting
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の殺し合いを始めればよい
findings.governingReading: then begin the final fight to the death
findings.explanation: The proposed lethal final contest becomes generic continued fighting.

findings.highlight: Is that fine with you, Lancer?
findings.evidenceJa: 決着をつけるのはその時でいいのではないかな
findings.governingReading: Would it not be enough to settle matters at that time, Lancer?
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s proposal to defer the decisive duel is omitted.

findings.highlight: We don’t need to go so far
findings.evidenceJa: そんな回りくどい事をする必要はない
findings.governingReading: There is no need for such a roundabout scheme.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s objection to contrivance becomes objection to degree or distance.

findings.highlight: It seems the man has reluctantly agreed
findings.evidenceJa: 不承不承に、その男は頷いたようだ
findings.governingReading: The man appears to nod, grudgingly.
findings.explanation: An observed uncertain gesture becomes abstract agreement.

findings.highlight: the thing that summoned us
findings.evidenceJa: オレたちを呼んだ連中
findings.governingReading: the people who summoned us
findings.explanation: Human summoners become a singular thing.

findings.highlight: the vessel in which the Holy Grail will appear
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を降ろす器
findings.governingReading: the vessel into which the Holy Grail is brought down
findings.explanation: The ritual descent relation is weakened into appearance.

findings.highlight: it should begin to acquire power as the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: すでに聖杯としての力を持ち始めていよう
findings.governingReading: it should already have begun to possess the Holy Grail’s power
findings.explanation: The vessel’s present partial activation is shifted into the future.

findings.highlight: You should understand
findings.evidenceJa: 薄々判っているのではないか
findings.governingReading: do you not have some dim understanding
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s probing claim about Saber’s partial knowledge becomes confident assertion.

findings.highlight: do you not think that is sad
findings.evidenceJa: それは空しいとは思わないか
findings.governingReading: do you not find that futile/empty
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s argument about purposeless sacrifice becomes an appeal to sadness.

findings.highlight: My head is grabbed and my body is lifted
findings.evidenceJa: 後ろから頭を掴まれて、体を持ち上げられたのか
findings.governingReading: Has he grabbed Shirou’s head from behind and lifted his body?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s disoriented inference is asserted as an objective action.

findings.highlight: The pain makes my vision go white
findings.evidenceJa: かろうじて生きていた視界が真白に戻る
findings.governingReading: the pain returns his barely surviving vision to pure white
findings.explanation: The personification tying sight to Shirou’s near-death state is omitted.

findings.highlight: not as lowly as you
findings.evidenceJa: おまえのような下衆ではない
findings.governingReading: is not scum like you
findings.explanation: Saber’s blunt moral contempt is softened into relative status language.

findings.highlight: that will not be his true opinion
findings.evidenceJa: それは本心ではあるまい
findings.governingReading: that cannot be his true heart/intention
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s conjectural challenge becomes an awkward future assertion about an opinion.

findings.highlight: this man also has a dark side
findings.evidenceJa: この男にも影はある
findings.governingReading: this man too has a shadow
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s metaphor of concealed psychic residue becomes a stock moral label.

findings.highlight: Nothing should come out of it
findings.evidenceJa: その先にあるものなんて、有るはずがない
findings.governingReading: There cannot possibly be anything beyond/ahead of that memory.
findings.explanation: Denial of what lies beyond the fire memory becomes denial that an action will produce a result.

findings.highlight: My mind reverses like electricity is running through it
findings.evidenceJa: 首の後ろに電流を流されたように、意識が裏返る
findings.governingReading: His consciousness turns inside out as though current were sent through the back of his neck.
findings.explanation: The bodily trigger and inside-out image are reassigned to electricity running through the mind.

findings.highlight: burned up corpses
findings.evidenceJa: 黒こげになってしまった死体
findings.governingReading: corpses charred black
findings.explanation: The visual blackness of the fire victims is weakened.

findings.highlight: I walked though it all
findings.evidenceJa: その中を歩いたんだ
findings.governingReading: I walked through it all.
findings.explanation: A basic typo mars the climactic admission.

findings.highlight: voices going mad trying to escape
findings.evidenceJa: 出してくれ、と咆える音
findings.governingReading: roars of “let me out”
findings.explanation: A quoted desperate demand and its roaring sound become an unsupported claim of madness.

findings.highlight: the pleas of mothers wanting me to take their children
findings.evidenceJa: この子も一緒に連れて行ってほしいという母親の懇願
findings.governingReading: a mother’s plea that he take her child with him too
findings.explanation: One concrete mother and child become generalized plurals.

findings.highlight: I thought I had to live even a second longer because I had to go that far
findings.evidenceJa: そこまでしたからには、一秒でも長く生きていなければ嘘だと思った
findings.governingReading: Having gone that far, he felt it would be a lie/betrayal unless he lived even one second longer.
findings.explanation: The moral consequence of abandoning others is rewritten as necessity forcing him to go that far.

findings.highlight: As long as I could do something, I thought I had to live
findings.evidenceJa: 為す術がある限り、自分は生きていなければ嘘だと思った
findings.governingReading: So long as any means remained, he felt failing to live would make his survival a lie.
findings.explanation: The repeated ethical image of survival becoming false is omitted.

findings.highlight: I knew…
findings.evidenceJa: ごめんなさいと
findings.governingReading: The thought “I’m sorry” rises, but he refuses to say it.
findings.explanation: The explicit apology he withholds is replaced by a generic bridge into explanation.

findings.highlight: children unfortunate enough to be in areas near where the fire occurred
findings.evidenceJa: 火事が起きた周りの家、飛び火を受けて不幸にあった家の子供たち
findings.governingReading: children from houses around the fire and from homes struck by spreading flames
findings.explanation: Two concretely distinguished groups of surrounding victims are collapsed into proximity to the fire.

findings.highlight: affection for those that died
findings.evidenceJa: 喪われた者への未練
findings.governingReading: lingering attachment and regret for those who were lost
findings.explanation: Bereavement that cannot let go becomes simple affection.

findings.highlight: I thought that…
findings.evidenceJa: その全てを
findings.governingReading: all of it—
findings.explanation: A suspended object leading into the duty to remember is rewritten as an added cognition clause.

findings.highlight: I had to remember every single bit of it
findings.evidenceJa: 記憶しなくちゃいけないと思った
findings.governingReading: he thought he had to remember it
findings.explanation: Unsupported exhaustive emphasis is added to Shirou’s self-imposed obligation.

findings.highlight: Give it back  give it back  give it back  give it back
findings.evidenceJa: 帰して　帰して　帰して　帰して
findings.governingReading: Send us/me back; let us/me go home.
findings.explanation: A distinct plea to be returned home is collapsed into the earlier demand to return an object.

findings.highlight: a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: an ally/champion of justice
findings.explanation: The defining ethical ideal is again replaced by a genre label.

findings.highlight: What was me crumbled away as I ignored the pleas for help
findings.evidenceJa: 助けを求める声を無視するたびに削れていって、跡形もなくなっていた
findings.governingReading: what had been himself was pared away each time he ignored a plea, until no trace remained
findings.explanation: Repeated incremental self-erasure and its completed result are weakened.

findings.highlight: I kept moving forward with an empty mind
findings.evidenceJa: 空っぽになった心で、それでも前に進まなければ許されない
findings.governingReading: with his heart emptied, he believed he could not be forgiven unless he kept moving forward
findings.explanation: The guilt-driven condition on survival and progress is omitted.

findings.highlight: The people I didn’t save taught me that I had to go on
findings.evidenceJa: 救わなかった、多くの死に教えられた
findings.governingReading: He was taught by the many deaths he had not saved.
findings.explanation: Deaths become people, and the English supplies a specific lesson absent from the fragment.

findings.highlight: I just thought about going forward
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を張って前に進む事だけを考えていた
findings.governingReading: he thought only of moving forward with his head/chest held high
findings.explanation: The bodily image of living proudly in the dead’s place is omitted.

findings.highlight: Memories of those who were my parents
findings.evidenceJa: 誰よりも近いところにいた、両親だったひとたちの記憶
findings.governingReading: memories of the people who had been his parents, closer to him than anyone
findings.explanation: The defining closeness of Shirou’s birth parents is omitted.

findings.highlight: don’t open that
findings.evidenceJa: その窓を、開けるな
findings.governingReading: do not open that window
findings.explanation: The recurring window metaphor for sealed memory is omitted.

findings.highlight: The pain in my chest
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に開いた傷の痛み
findings.governingReading: the pain of the wound opened in his chest
findings.explanation: The physical wound returning Shirou to the present becomes generic chest pain.

findings.highlight: my head is burning
findings.evidenceJa: 頭は沸騰しそうなほど熱い
findings.governingReading: his head is hot enough that it feels ready to boil
findings.explanation: The extreme boiling sensation is weakened to a stock phrase.

findings.highlight: My breathing is ragged
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸はだらしなく途切れ
findings.governingReading: his breathing breaks off helplessly and without control
findings.explanation: The loss of bodily discipline is reduced to generic ragged breathing.

findings.highlight: What hurts is the pain inside
findings.evidenceJa: 痛むのは中の傷だ
findings.governingReading: What aches is the wound inside him.
findings.explanation: The unhealable psychic wound becomes an abstract inner pain.

findings.highlight: It will keep hurting as long as the memory is there, and it will never heal
findings.evidenceJa: 痛み続け、腫れ上がり、癒える事などありえない
findings.governingReading: it will keep hurting and swelling as long as that memory exists, never healing
findings.explanation: The grotesque swelling of the internal wound is omitted.

findings.highlight: I see a figure that should not be here
findings.evidenceJa: いるはずのない彼女の姿が見えた
findings.governingReading: he sees her figure, though she should not be there
findings.explanation: Saber is reduced to an unidentified figure at the moment her image sustains him.

findings.highlight: I have to act like I’m all right
findings.evidenceJa: 大丈夫だって、胸を、張らないと
findings.governingReading: he has to thrust out his chest and show her he is all right
findings.explanation: A bodily performance of courage before Saber becomes generic pretense.

findings.highlight: so that no one would be hurt
findings.evidenceJa: 誰一人として死なないように
findings.governingReading: so that not a single person would die
findings.explanation: The desired reversal is weakened from preventing death to preventing injury.

findings.highlight: with my burning head
findings.evidenceJa: 加熱した頭で、何も考えられなくなった思考で
findings.governingReading: with his overheated head and thoughts no longer capable of thinking
findings.explanation: The cognitive collapse accompanying the physical heat is omitted.

findings.highlight: My fingers feel the wet floor
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みに耐える指が、びちゃりと湿った床に触れる
findings.governingReading: his pain-enduring fingers touch the wet floor with a splat
findings.explanation: Agency, endurance, and the wet impact sound are omitted.

findings.highlight: They all want to go back to that day
findings.evidenceJa: 死んでいる筈の彼らは、声を揃えて、あの日に戻りたいと願っている
findings.governingReading: Those who should be dead join their voices in wishing to return to that day.
findings.explanation: The impossible chorus of the dead is reduced to an unvoiced collective desire.

findings.highlight: though it can’t have been as bad as you guys
findings.evidenceJa: おまえたちにはおよびもしないだろうけど
findings.governingReading: though his longing cannot begin to compare with theirs
findings.explanation: A limit on comparison becomes a colloquial ranking of how bad experiences were.

findings.highlight: I went to the burned field often
findings.evidenceJa: 何度も何度も焼け野原に足を運んで
findings.governingReading: he returned to the burned wasteland again and again
findings.explanation: The obsessive repetition and desolate terrain are weakened.

findings.highlight: walked through the hallway that didn’t exist
findings.evidenceJa: 誰もいない廊下を歩いて
findings.governingReading: walked down the hallway where no one was
findings.explanation: A surviving imagined space emptied of family is changed into a nonexistent structure.

findings.highlight: The priest with the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を司る神父
findings.governingReading: the priest who presides over the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s ritual authority becomes mere possession or proximity.

findings.highlight: If fate had taken a slight turn, I would be there as well
findings.evidenceJa: 少し運命が違っていれば、俺もそうであった死者の海
findings.governingReading: a sea of dead among whom he too would lie had fate differed slightly
findings.explanation: The sea-of-corpses image and Shirou’s identification with the dead are flattened into location.

findings.highlight: the dead corpses
findings.evidenceJa: 死者を見て
findings.governingReading: written “the dead,” read “them”
findings.explanation: A humanizing written/ruby relation becomes redundant, dehumanizing English.

findings.highlight: And I reject them
findings.evidenceJa: 歯を食いしばって、否定した
findings.governingReading: He grits his teeth and rejects the wish.
findings.explanation: The bodily effort required for Shirou’s refusal is omitted.

findings.highlight: regenerate the dead
findings.evidenceJa: 死者を蘇らせる事
findings.governingReading: bring the dead back to life
findings.explanation: Resurrection is rendered as physical regeneration.

findings.highlight: I must not take back what has already happened
findings.evidenceJa: 起きた事を戻してはならない
findings.governingReading: he must not undo what has happened
findings.explanation: Reversal of history becomes an unnatural act of “taking back” events.

findings.highlight: That cold reality that hurts my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を抉った、あの、現実の冷たさ
findings.governingReading: the coldness of that reality which gouged his chest
findings.explanation: A violent bodily metaphor becomes conventional emotional hurt.

findings.highlight: There were people who mourned for the deaths
findings.evidenceJa: 彼らの死を悼み、長い日々を越えてきた人がいた
findings.governingReading: There were people who mourned their deaths and made it through long years/days afterward.
findings.explanation: The survivors’ prolonged labor of living beyond grief is omitted.

findings.highlight: To continue on remembering the pain and the weight
findings.evidenceJa: その痛みと重さを抱えて進む事
findings.governingReading: to move forward carrying that pain and weight
findings.explanation: An embodied ongoing burden is reduced to recollection.

findings.highlight: A death is painful
findings.evidenceJa: 死は悲しく
findings.governingReading: death is sorrowful
findings.explanation: The passage’s distinction between grief and pain is collapsed.

findings.highlight: memories become constraints
findings.evidenceJa: 思い出は礎となって
findings.governingReading: memories become a foundation
findings.explanation: The positive structural support of memory is reversed into restriction.

findings.highlight: for the people I’ve left behind
findings.evidenceJa: 置き去りにしてきた物の為にも
findings.governingReading: for the sake also of what he has left behind
findings.explanation: The deliberately broad remnants of Shirou’s past are narrowed to people.

findings.highlight: I can’t stray from my path
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を曲げる事なんて、出来ない
findings.governingReading: he cannot bend or betray himself
findings.explanation: Self-integrity becomes adherence to an abstract route.

findings.highlight: I declare so within my pain
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みを堪えて告げた
findings.governingReading: He says it while enduring the pain.
findings.explanation: Endurance is replaced by awkward spatial phrasing.

findings.highlight: I control the pain and my fading consciousness
findings.evidenceJa: 消え去り、倒れそうになる意識を必死に押さえて
findings.governingReading: desperately holds down his fading consciousness as it threatens to collapse
findings.explanation: The English adds control of pain and weakens the desperate prevention of mental collapse.

findings.highlight: stay up on my knees
findings.evidenceJa: 地面に蹲る
findings.governingReading: crouches/huddles on the ground
findings.explanation: A collapsed crouch becomes successfully remaining upright on his knees.

findings.highlight: they closed their eyes without a single grudge
findings.evidenceJa: 恨み言を遺さず、目を閉じてくれた
findings.governingReading: they closed their eyes without leaving him any words of resentment
findings.explanation: Absence of an expressed reproach is promoted into absence of resentment itself.

findings.highlight: it is sad
findings.evidenceJa: 悲しいと言えば悲しかった
findings.governingReading: if he were to call it sad, then it was sad
findings.explanation: The restrained, qualified closing judgment becomes a flat declaration.
